news.headline: Brookline starts Perimeter at buy; PT C$1.54
news.summary: Brookline Capital Markets initiated research coverage on Perimeter Medical Imaging AI with a Buy rating and a C$1.54 price target, citing Claire's FDA Breakthrough Device status and the company's pending CMS New Technology APC reimbursement filing, with a decision expected by year-end 2026. The stock had closed at C$0.32 on July 13, 2026 ahead of the initiation.

news.headline: Paradigm Capital names Perimeter a healthcare Top Pick
news.summary: Paradigm Capital named Perimeter Medical Imaging AI a new healthcare Top Pick with a speculative buy rating and a C$0.95 price target, following the FDA's March 2026 premarket approval of the Claire OCT imaging device for intraoperative breast cancer margin assessment. Paradigm was also a lead agent on Perimeter's spring 2026 financings.

news.headline: Perimeter Medical Imaging AI to Participate in the Planet MicroCap Showcase in Las Vegas
news.summary: Perimeter announced that CEO Adrian Mendes would present a corporate update on the company's commercial strategy and upcoming milestones at the Planet MicroCap Showcase in Las Vegas on June 17, 2026. The presentation gave investors a post-FDA-approval update on Claire and S-Series OCT commercialization progress.

news.headline: Perimeter Selected for INOVAIT Pilot Fund to Advance AI for Breast Cancer Surgery
news.summary: Perimeter Medical Imaging AI was selected to receive a contribution from the INOVAIT Pilot Fund, plus a Mitacs award, to help advance next-generation AI capabilities for its flagship Claire imaging device. The funding supports continued development of the AI-enabled OCT platform used for real-time breast cancer surgical margin assessment.

news.headline: Perimeter Medical Imaging AI Closes Final Tranche of Non-Brokered Private Placement
news.summary: Perimeter closed the second and final tranche of its non-brokered private placement of convertible debentures, issuing CDN$3,280,000 in principal and bringing aggregate proceeds from the two-tranche offering to CDN$6,040,000 (including CDN$2,760,000 taken up by CEO Adrian Mendes in the first tranche). The debenture financing followed the company's earlier LIFE Offering and adds to cash reserves supporting continued commercialization of Claire and the S-Series OCT platform.

catalysts.label: CMS New Technology APC decision for Claire OCT
catalysts.detail: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services is expected to rule on Perimeter's New Technology Ambulatory Payment Classification (NT-APC) filing for Claire under the Medicare Outpatient Prospective Payment System; Claire's FDA Breakthrough Device status is expected to expedite the review.

catalysts.label: Potential NT-APC reimbursement effective date
catalysts.detail: If CMS grants New Technology APC status following a June filing cycle, incremental Medicare reimbursement for Claire procedures would take effect around January 1, 2027 and remain in place for roughly 2-3 years while claims data is collected ahead of reassignment to a standard APC.

catalysts.label: Second quarter 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Perimeter is expected to report Q2 2026 (period ended June 30, 2026) financial and operating results; third-party earnings calendars project a report date around September 1, 2026, though no official date had been announced by the company as of August 5, 2026. This will be the first quarter to include any Claire procedure revenue.

pulse: Perimeter Medical Imaging AI continues commercializing Claire, the first FDA-approved AI-enabled OCT imaging device for real-time intraoperative breast cancer margin assessment, while expanding its base of S-Series OCT hospital placements; June 2026 brought an INOVAIT pilot grant to advance Claire's AI capabilities and the close of a CDN$6.04 million convertible debenture financing (heavily backed by CEO Adrian Mendes), extending the company's cash runway. Sell-side sentiment turned notably more constructive in early-to-mid July, with Paradigm Capital naming Perimeter a healthcare Top Pick (speculative buy, C$0.95 target) on July 6 and Brookline Capital Markets initiating coverage with a Buy rating and a C$1.54 price target on July 14, both anchored on the pending CMS New Technology APC reimbursement decision expected by year-end 2026. Company-specific news flow has been quiet since the Brookline initiation, with the next major catalyst likely to be Q2 2026 financial results (third-party trackers point to early September, not yet officially confirmed) followed by progress on the Medicare reimbursement pathway seen as key to broader hospital adoption economics.
